description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Linked Materia Mode (Fire, Lightning)], [Awoken Eager Elite Mode] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Damage Cap +10000] to Reno, Rude and the user if Reno is alive, grants [Fire/Earth/Lightning Ability +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if Reno is alive, grants [Quick Cast] to all allies if Rude is alive

description.name: Awoken Eager Elite Mode
description.text: Fire and Lightning abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Fire and Lightning abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Sparking Shot after using after using Fire and Lightning abilities

description.name: Sparking Shot
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (0.71 each), grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)] and [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)] to the user every second cast

description.name: Buff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Linked Materia Mode (Fire, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire] after using a Fire ability, grants [Attach Lightning] after using a Lightning ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Fire/Earth/Lightning Ability +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Fire, Earth or Lightning abilities deal 30% more damage
